about: Every publication this project prepares, and where each one stands. docs/PUBLISHING-PAPERS.md explains the steps and the statuses; node tools/paper-check.js checks each entry against its files, and allows no email address in a paper's files except author.email. Update this file in the pull request that changes a status.

papers.title: Minimal Winding in the Self-Similar Collapse of Point Vortices
papers.note: Ready again (2026-09-25). The parts merged in from the alpha-model draft (Sections 4 to 8) had two recorded adversarial second readings, and their must-fix findings are fixed; release 2.1.0 of the companion carries the corrected paper, and the paper's data availability paragraph cites its DOI, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22966989. By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) arXiv is deferred until an endorsement. By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) the alpha-model draft (formerly alpha-winding) is merged into this paper, which also carries the computer-assisted proofs for four or more vortices; the title changed with the merge. Earlier releases of the companion: 1.0.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22953035 (2026-09-25, before the central-vortex result and the merge), and 2.0.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22963796. Release 2.2.0, prepared on 2026-09-27 and not yet made, adds the explicit forms and examples of the identities note, which by the owner's decision (2026-09-27) is retired and gets no record of its own (identities/README.md), and the credits to Chen, Walsh and Wheeler and to Yudovich; its additions had four in-project adversarial readings on 2026-09-27, the third and the fourth briefed only with the paper and its programs (the third: minor revision, no must-fix; the fourth, narrow, of the newest passages: one must-fix and two should-fix findings), whose confirmed findings are fixed and recorded in notes/QUALITY.md, item 6, notes/review-identities-2026-09-27.md, notes/review-identities-3-2026-09-27.md and notes/review-identities-4-2026-09-27.md (42 pages; 152 checks in verify_general_mu.py and 103 in verify_central_vortex.py); none is an outside review, and the quality record, notes/QUALITY.md, is complete. Release 2.2.0 is archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22994932 (2026-09-27).

papers.title: Point-Vortex Collapse Without Rotation: A Cluster Mechanism, a Phase Diagram and a Continuum Limit
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's decision (2026-09-25), with the registry's author block as for minimal-winding, which it cites as its companion paper. O'Neil, Theor. Comput. Fluid Dyn. 24 (2010) 39-44, read in full (2026-09-25) and credited in Section 6; a second reader has checked the draft and its corrections are in. Ready for its first release in its companion repository, archived on Zenodo for a DOI (owner's decision, 2026-09-25); Aref et al., Vortex crystals (2003), read and cited; O'Neil 2013 read in summary only. No journal chosen yet.

papers.title: Stable Self-Similar Expansion of Four and Five Point Vortices and Confinement of Vortex Patches
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's decision (2026-09-25): computer-assisted proof that four and five Euler vortices have self-similarly expanding configurations that are stable modulo rotation and their family, linearly and nonlinearly (orbital asymptotic stability with the rate 1/size, the limit fixed by the energy, and an a priori estimate for forced motions), and Zbarsky's vortex-patch confinement theorem carried over to them. By the owner's decision (2026-09-25) it gets its first release in its companion repository, archived on Zenodo for a DOI, once its quality record is complete. Theorem 4 is proved in full in Appendix A (2026-09-26); independent readings of every section and of the programs are recorded in notes/QUALITY.md with their fixes; the owner signed off and the quality bar is met (2026-09-26). Zbarsky is cited by the section and equation numbers of arXiv:1912.10862v2; the published CMP version was not accessible. Kallyadan and Shukla, Phys. Rev. Fluids 7 (2022) 114701, is cited for background from its abstract. Leoncini, El Kettani and Ugalde, arXiv:2609.25989, read and cited. No journal chosen yet.

papers.title: A finite rank window cannot show that a neural population code satisfies the eigenspectrum smoothness bound
papers.note: Drafted in this repository by the owner's standing decision (2026-09-26): a methods note showing that exponents fitted over a finite rank window cannot test the eigenspectrum smoothness bound of Stringer et al. (2019); three in-project referee readings, the fixes of the third not read again; a full rerun from the downloaded inputs on 2026-09-27 reproduces every stored value (notes/rerun-2026-09-27.md). Release 1.0.0 is archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22994835 (2026-09-27).

papers.title: Hopf Bifurcations and Bistability in the Hodgkin-Huxley Equations at the 1952 Parameters: Computer-Assisted Proofs
papers.note: Computer-assisted proofs, for every leak potential in [10.59, 10.62], of the unique equilibrium for J in [0, 200], its two Hopf points (subcritical and supercritical, first Lyapunov coefficients enclosed) and bistability of rest and repetitive firing at J = 8. Six in-project readings by separate agents (2026-09-27), every must-fix finding fixed (notes/referee-2026-09-27-*.md), and a mutation study of the programs (data/mutation_study.txt). Du and Hassard (2001) computed Hopf coefficients of the model in interval arithmetic; only its first page could be read, and no priority is claimed for the equilibria, the Hopf points or their criticality. Release 1.0.0 is archived at doi:10.5281/zenodo.22996260 (2026-09-27).
